children: Citigroup Inc. launched Citi Premium Boost, offering higher savings rates tied to required activities for Citi Priority, Citigold, and Citigold Private Client tiers. New clients opening Citi Savings and Regular Checking from Oct. 26 will be auto-enrolled.
Signals push to deepen deposits/wealth ties, potentially aiding NIM and retention.
Activity-gated rates can drive direct deposit capture and cross-sell.
Frictionless onboarding could speed adoption and deposit inflows.
Focus on affluent clients may lift fee/wealth revenue mix.
Easier setup can lock primary bank status and lower churn.

This fits Citi’s ongoing shift to a simpler, unified relationship-banking model with emphasis on wealth and deposits. For this to be a larger catalyst, Citi would need to disclose adoption, deposit inflows, and margin/fee impacts in upcoming results.
